title: Dimension is unchanged under base change along field extensions
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $A$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] and $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then the Krull dimensions [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] of the rings $A\otimes_kK$ and $A$ agree: $\dim(A\otimes_kK)=\dim A$. Hence for a curve $X$ over $k$ [def-pc-curve], the base change [def-pc-base-change] $X_K=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec} k}\operatorname{Spec} K$ has dimension $1$ [def-pc-dimension].

proof.text: *Affine statement.* By [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-preserved-field-extension] (Algebra, Lemma 00P3, applied to $S=A$), the topological spaces $\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kA)$ and $\operatorname{Spec}A$ have the same Krull dimension. By [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] the Krull dimension of a ring is the Krull dimension of its spectrum, so $\dim(K\otimes_kA)=\dim A$. Finally $A\otimes_kK\cong K\otimes_kA$ as rings by $a\otimes c\mapsto c\otimes a$, and isomorphic rings have the same Krull dimension (prime ideals correspond, preserving inclusions). Hence $\dim(A\otimes_kK)=\dim A$.

*An affine cover of $X$ and of $X_K$.* Let $X$ be a curve over $k$ [def-pc-curve]: an integral (in particular nonempty) scheme whose structure morphism $f:X	o\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated and of finite type, with $\dim X=1$. Since $f$ is of finite type and $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is affine with $f^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}k)=X$, by [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] $X$ has a finite affine open cover $X=U_1\cup\dots\cup U_m$, $U_i\cong\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ with each $A_i$ a finitely generated, i.e. finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], $k$-algebra. Let $p:X_K	o X$ and $q:X_K	o\operatorname{Spec}K$ be the projections of $X_K=X	imes_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-base-change]. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] (with $S=U=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $V=U_i$, $W=Y=\operatorname{Spec}K$) the open subscheme $p^{-1}(U_i)\subseteq X_K$ is identified with $U_i	imes_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K$, which by [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] is $\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A_i\otimes_kK)$. As the $U_i$ cover $X$, the $p^{-1}(U_i)$ cover $X_K$; and $X_K$ is nonempty, since $X$ is nonempty, so some $A_i
eq0$, and then $\dim(A_i\otimes_kK)=\dim A_i\ge0$ by step 1, so $A_i\otimes_kK
e0$ and $p^{-1}(U_i)
eq\emptyset$.

proof.text: *Conclusion.* By [lem-pc-dimension-affine-open-cover] applied to the nonempty scheme $X$ with the cover $(U_i)$, $1=\dim X=\max_i\dim A_i$; applied to the nonempty scheme $X_K$ with the cover $(p^{-1}(U_i))$, and with step 1 for each $A_i$ (a finite type $k$-algebra), $\dim X_K=\max_i\dim(A_i\otimes_kK)=\max_i\dim A_i=1$.
